citation_problems.citation: [[milan-european-offering-golive]] MN_07/2026, 8 September 2026, PDF 2 (section 1 'Scope of the new model')
citation_problems.problem: Minor locator imprecision: the paragraph cites PDF 2 alone, but its opening scope bullets (equity trades on Amsterdam, Brussels and Paris; euro ETP trades on Amsterdam and Paris) are printed on PDF 1; the MIC list, alternative-CSD sentence, first-ISD sentence, derivatives and 'remain unchanged' sentences are on PDF 2 as cited. The Direct answer cites the same content correctly as PDF 1–2, so the reader is not misled; recorded but not scored down.
citation_problems.passage_quote: [PDF page 1] ... As of this date, Euronext Securities Milan will become the designated place of settlement for: • Equity trades executed on Euronext Amsterdam, Brussels and Paris markets; and • ETP trades denominated in euro executed on Euronext Amsterdam and Paris markets. ... [PDF page 2] The migration applies to Equity and ETP transactions executed on the following MICs: • XAMS • XBRU • XPAR • MLXB • XMLI • ALXB • ALXP

unsupported_claims: Minor, non-operational: the caution 'Roles are relational and defined per securities issue' (section 1) and the open-item remark that 'the library records the Milan timetable notice chain as unresolved, gap G01' are not in the bundle; both are protective framing rather than claims about how the Paris trades settle, and neither asserts a field, time, version, fee, eligibility, deployment or legal effect. The weekday statement (21 September 2026 Monday, 23 September Wednesday) is labelled reasoned inference and is corroborated by ON_31/2026 'Wednesday 23rd September 2026'.
reason: Every element of the hidden key point is present and entailed by [[milan-european-offering-golive]]: 'Euronext Securities Milan confirms that the go-live of the Euronext European Offering will take place as planned on 21 September 2026', 'will become the designated place of settlement for: • Equity trades executed on Euronext Amsterdam, Brussels and Paris markets', the MIC list including XPAR, XMLI and ALXP, 'Trading Members may designate an alternative settlement system in place of Euronext Securities Milan', and 'Transactions executed on or after 21 September 2026 under the new model will have 23 September 2026 as their first intended settlement date (ISD)'. The fail condition is absent: the answer repeatedly states the go-live is 'announced, not proven live' as at the 14 September 2026 review date, carrying the LIMITATION 'Announced go-live, not proof of live operation; place-of-settlement details for individual instruments require the programme documents' plus the market-notice, Italian-authoritative/translation, approval, reference_description and future-mode qualifications. The CSDR Article 5(2) 'no later than on the second business day' ceiling, the 2025/2075 'first business day' amendment 'apply from 11 October 2027' and the ON_31/2026 ETP issuer-CSD migration are quoted accurately with correct review dates (2026-09-13 / 2026-09-14) and explicitly kept separate from the equity question, with inferences and design choices labelled.
